title: Verizon May Be an AI Infrastructure Stock Hiding in Plain Sight
excerpt: Verizon's over $1 billion dark fiber deal with Alphabet highlights AI-driven growth, as improving cash flow, margins, and buybacks support its dividend and d...
content_html:
Key Points

  • Interested in Verizon Communications Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • Verizon's dark fiber deal with Alphabet gives the telecom company a direct connection to the AI infrastructure buildout.

  • The company's Q2 results showed stronger free cash flow, margin improvement and disciplined subscriber growth despite lower equipment revenue.

  • Verizon's debt load remains a key risk, but higher cash flow, buybacks and a large dividend keep the stock attractive for income investors.

Verizon (NYSE: VZ) is an AI-enabler of first-class quality, and it isn't getting enough attention. Its fiber optic networks are critical for AI connectivity, spanning all levels of the stack from data centers to devices. While not a semiconductor manufacturer, networker, or model builder, AI data can't get where it needs to go without the long-haul and metropolitan fiber networks on which Verizon's business is built. It is the data highway hyperscalers need, and the deal with Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) is the proof.

Verizon CEO Dan Schulman unveiled an industry-unlocking event when he announced that Alphabet would rent its dark fiber. Worth more than $1 billion in revenue, it is expected to be the first of many such deals as hyperscalers rush to lock in long-distance fiber-optic capacity.

→ Volatility Is Back and These 3 Market Tollbooths Are Best Positioned to Profit

The impact on Verizon's revenue, cash flow, and earnings will be monumental, as the dark fiber networks already exist, as they are leftover, unused capacity dating back to the DotCom boom. The takeaway is that Verizon is unlocking unused assets in a high-margin fashion, with little to no start-up costs and Google footing the hardware bill; it will buy the machines to power the system and transmit the data while Verizon collects rent fees.

Verizon Improves Capital Position and Capacity for Capital Return

The dark fiber rent fees equate to growth, margin improvement, and a strengthened capital position, with Verizon already on track for balance sheet improvement and paying attractive dividends. Distributions annualize to roughly 6% with shares trading near late-July highs, more than 3x the S&P 500 average, with distributions expected to grow over time. As it stands, Verizon will be included in key indices such as the Dividend Achievers, a listing of stocks with at least 25 years of annual distribution increases, within the next few years, and share buybacks are also in play.

→ This Tiny AI Supplier Could Be More Important Than the Chipmakers

content_html_zh:
要点

  • 对威瑞森通信公司感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • Verizon 与 Alphabet 的暗光纤协议使这家电信公司能够直接连接到人工智能基础设施建设。
  • 尽管设备收入较低，但该公司第二季度的业绩显示，自由现金流强劲，利润率提高，用户增长稳定。
  • Verizon 的债务负担仍然是一个主要风险，但较高的现金流、回购和大额股息使该股票对收入投资者具有吸引力。

Verizon（纽约证券交易所股票代码：VZ）是一家品质一流的人工智能推动者，但它并没有得到足够的关注。 其光纤网络对于人工智能连接至关重要，涵盖从数据中心到设备的各个层面。 虽然 Verizon 不是半导体制造商、网络商或模型构建商，但如果没有 Verizon 业务所依赖的长途和城域光纤网络，人工智能数据就无法到达需要的地方。 这是超大规模企业所需的数据高速公路，与 Alphabet（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOGL）的交易就是证明。

Verizon 首席执行官丹·舒尔曼 (Dan Schulman) 宣布 Alphabet 将租用其暗光纤，开启了一项行业解锁活动。 随着超大规模企业急于锁定长距离光纤容量，该交易的收入预计将超过 10 亿美元，预计将成为众多此类交易中的第一笔。

→ 波动性又回来了，这 3 个市场收费站最有可能获利

这对 Verizon 的收入、现金流和收益的影响将是巨大的，因为暗光纤网络已经存在，因为它们是互联网繁荣时期剩余的、未使用的容量。 结论是，Verizon 正在以高利润的方式释放未使用的资产，几乎没有甚至没有启动成本，而谷歌则承担硬件费用；它将购买机器为系统供电并传输数据，而 Verizon 则收取租金。

Verizon 改善资本状况和资本回报能力

暗光纤租金相当于增长、利润率改善和资本状况增强，而 Verizon 已经有望改善资产负债表并支付有吸引力的股息。 股息年率约为 6%，股价接近 7 月下旬的高点，是标准普尔 500 指数平均水平的 3 倍以上，且股息预计将随着时间的推移而增长。 目前来看，Verizon 将被纳入未来几年内股息实现者指数等关键指数，该指数列出了至少 25 年年度分配增长的股票，并且股票回购也在发挥作用。

→ 这个小小的人工智能供应商可能比芯片制造商更重要
